prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-resolution landscape design comparison board for ALDA CONNECT, a premium fitness and health web app, with one spacious desktop trainer dashboard on the left and two complete portrait mobile client screens on the right, one light mode and one dark mode. Flat crisp UI, no browser window, no desk scene. All app text in Bosnian, readable and concise. Fictional demonstration only. Desktop trainer Alda: navigation Pregled, Klijenti, Planovi, Kalendar, Poruke; title "Dobar dan, Alda"; useful task queue showing "Amrudin · Pregled sedmice", "Plan treninga", and button "Pozovi klijenta". Show a clean weekly calendar and client activity list. Mobile client Amrudin: heading "Tvoj dan", prominent "Trening snage", "5 vježbi · 45 min", button "Započni trening"; secondary Ishrana, Oporavak, Moj tim, and "Testni nalaz · Čeka pregled". Bottom navigation Danas, Plan, Napredak, Poruke, Više. Usable thumb-sized controls, disciplined hierarchy, precise typography and ample space, credible fully working product aesthetic. Avoid clinical claims, invented outcomes, real health values, oversized decorative empty panels, excessive metrics, gold gradients or ornamental luxury logos.  Board title at top: "07 — LONGEVITY ATELIER". Visual direction: premium contemporary longevity and wellness studio. Porcelain white and soft mineral grey, dark aubergine typography and plum primary controls with muted botanical green secondary signals. Refined humanist sans-serif throughout, exceptionally considered whitespace and asymmetrical but practical desktop columns. Calm substantial cards, subtle tonal surfaces, understated fine-line icons. Dark mode rich charcoal-plum with warm pale text. One signature vertical daily itinerary on the client screen. Feel sophisticated and welcoming with serious expert care, not generic pastel spa branding.
